    About the data

    Two modules, one survey

    Module 1 is the Africa Digital Health Maturity Assessment Tool (ADHMAT): 373 Yes / No / N/A questions across five domains plus a supplementary Digital Payment Systems section. Module 2 is the Member State Qualitative Input Questionnaire: narrative and structured answers on progress, results, barriers and priorities.

    How scores are worked out

    • Each question is scored on its own: Yes = 1, No = 0. N/A is left out.
    • Sub-domain score = Yes ÷ (Yes + No). Domain score = average of its sub-domains. Overall score = average of the five domains A to E.
    • Digital Payment Systems is reported separately and does not enter the overall score.

    Maturity levels

    Who is counted

    Continental figures use countries whose ADHMAT module is complete. Countries with an assessment in progress appear on the map with hatching and a partial score, and are left out of the continental figures.

    How to read the results

    • All answers are self-reported by the national focal point. Uploaded documents and the A to E evidence ratings show how much support each answer has.
    • This is the first round, so it sets the baseline. Trends will be possible when countries repeat the assessment.
    • The scores explain and complement the Digital Health Index findings. They are not intended to rank Member States.

    This version

    All figures here come from sample data generated for the 55 Member States to test the layout, filters and map. When real survey data is available, the same views will read from it.
